onOpenChange.description: TS: ((open: boolean, eventDetails: AccordionItemChangeEventDetails) => void) | undefined. Not expressible in JSON Schema, checked by tsc. onOpenChange is a callback, not a value `(open: boolean, eventDetails) => void` - a function of Base UI's own event-details object. No JSON Schema type covers a function.

render.description: TS: ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | ComponentRenderFn<HTMLProps, AccordionItemState> | undefined. Not expressible in JSON Schema, checked by tsc. render replaces the item element with one the caller supplies Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the item's state; neither is expressible in JSON Schema.

style.description: TS: CSSProperties | ((state: AccordionItemState) => CSSProperties | undefined) | undefined. Not expressible in JSON Schema, checked by tsc. style accepts a function of the item's state as well as a plain style object Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)`; a JSON Schema `object` would reject the function form.

value.description: TS: any. Not expressible in JSON Schema, checked by tsc. value is an opaque identifier, typed `any` by Base UI Base UI's Accordion.Item declares `value?: any` - it is compared by identity against the root's `value`/`defaultValue` array and never interpreted, so the primitive types it as anything. Strings are what accordion.md uses, and what a reader should reach for.

x-gts-traits.intent: One collapsible section of an Accordion, identified by a unique value.
typical_uses: One entry in an Accordion's list of sections, wrapping a trigger and its panel

dont_use_when.situation: A section that must always stay visible and never collapse

invariants.text: `value` identifies this item within its root; it is what `Accordion`'s `value`/`defaultValue` name to control or default which item is open.

anti_patterns.dont: Reuse the same `value` for two items under one Accordion root
anti_patterns.do_instead: Give every item a unique `value` - see the root's item-values-unique-per-root invariant

a11y.by: Base UI's Accordion.Item - the item's own disclosure state and its wiring to the root

good.title: An item with its trigger and panel
good.code:
<AccordionItem value="item-1">
  <AccordionTrigger>Is it accessible?</AccordionTrigger>
  <AccordionContent>Yes. It adheres to the WAI-ARIA design pattern.</AccordionContent>
</AccordionItem>

bad.title: An item outside any Accordion
bad.why: AccordionItem has no open/close state of its own - it reads and writes the nearest Accordion root's state, so mounting it outside one renders nothing usable.
